info.name: F5 Load Balancer F5 BIG-IP iControl REST API
Virtual Servers
F5 Load Balancer List all virtual servers

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to include in the response.

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression to restrict returned resources.

params.name: $top
params.description: Maximum number of resources to return.

params.name: $skip
params.description: Number of resources to skip before returning results.

params.name: expandSubcollections
params.description: When set to true, inline sub-collections in the response.

items.docs: Retrieves a collection of all virtual server resources configured on the BIG-IP system. Returns virtual server properties including destination address, pool assignment, profiles, and operational state.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Create a virtual server

items.docs: Creates a new virtual server resource on the BIG-IP system. The virtual server defines a traffic destination address and port to which the BIG-IP listens for client connections.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Get a specific virtual server

params.name: virtualName
params.description: Name of the virtual server resource, optionally prefixed with the partition path (e.g., ~Common~my_virtual).

items.docs: Retrieves a single virtual server resource identified by name, including all of its configuration properties and operational state.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Update a virtual server

params.name: virtualName
params.description: Name of the virtual server resource, optionally prefixed with the partition path (e.g., ~Common~my_virtual).

items.docs: Replaces the configuration of an existing virtual server resource. All writable properties should be included in the request body.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Partially update a virtual server

params.name: virtualName
params.description: Name of the virtual server resource, optionally prefixed with the partition path (e.g., ~Common~my_virtual).

items.docs: Modifies specific properties of an existing virtual server without requiring the full resource representation.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Delete a virtual server

params.name: virtualName
params.description: Name of the virtual server resource, optionally prefixed with the partition path (e.g., ~Common~my_virtual).

items.docs: Removes a virtual server resource from the BIG-IP system. Existing connections may be disrupted depending on the virtual server state.

info.name: Pools
F5 Load Balancer List all pools

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to include in the response.

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression to restrict returned resources.

params.name: $top
params.description: Maximum number of resources to return.

params.name: $skip
params.description: Number of resources to skip before returning results.

params.name: expandSubcollections
params.description: When set to true, inline sub-collections in the response.

items.docs: Retrieves a collection of all load balancing pool resources configured on the BIG-IP system. Pools contain members that receive traffic distributed by virtual servers.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Create a pool

items.docs: Creates a new load balancing pool on the BIG-IP system. A pool is a collection of backend server members to which the BIG-IP distributes client traffic.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Get a specific pool

params.name: poolName
params.description: Name of the pool resource, optionally prefixed with the partition path (e.g., ~Common~my_pool).

items.docs: Retrieves a single pool resource identified by name including its configuration and load balancing settings.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Update a pool

params.name: poolName
params.description: Name of the pool resource, optionally prefixed with the partition path (e.g., ~Common~my_pool).

items.docs: Replaces the configuration of an existing pool resource.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Delete a pool

params.name: poolName
params.description: Name of the pool resource, optionally prefixed with the partition path (e.g., ~Common~my_pool).

items.docs: Removes a pool resource from the BIG-IP system. Any virtual servers referencing this pool should be updated before deletion.

info.name: Pool Members
F5 Load Balancer List pool members

params.name: poolName
params.description: Name of the pool resource, optionally prefixed with the partition path (e.g., ~Common~my_pool).

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to include in the response.

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression to restrict returned resources.

items.docs: Retrieves a collection of all members within a specific pool including their addresses, ports, and operational states.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Add a member to a pool

params.name: poolName
params.description: Name of the pool resource, optionally prefixed with the partition path (e.g., ~Common~my_pool).

items.docs: Adds a new server member to the specified pool. The member is identified by its node address and service port.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Get a specific pool member

params.name: poolName
params.description: Name of the pool resource, optionally prefixed with the partition path (e.g., ~Common~my_pool).

params.name: memberName
params.description: Name of the pool member in address:port format (e.g., ~Common~10.0.0.1:80).

items.docs: Retrieves a single pool member resource including its configuration, health status, and statistics.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Update a pool member

params.name: poolName
params.description: Name of the pool resource, optionally prefixed with the partition path (e.g., ~Common~my_pool).

params.name: memberName
params.description: Name of the pool member in address:port format (e.g., ~Common~10.0.0.1:80).

items.docs: Replaces the configuration of a specific pool member.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Remove a pool member

params.name: poolName
params.description: Name of the pool resource, optionally prefixed with the partition path (e.g., ~Common~my_pool).

params.name: memberName
params.description: Name of the pool member in address:port format (e.g., ~Common~10.0.0.1:80).

items.docs: Removes a server member from the specified pool.

info.name: Nodes
F5 Load Balancer List all nodes

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to include in the response.

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression to restrict returned resources.

params.name: $top
params.description: Maximum number of resources to return.

params.name: $skip
params.description: Number of resources to skip before returning results.

items.docs: Retrieves a collection of all node resources on the BIG-IP system. Nodes represent backend servers identified by their IP addresses or FQDNs.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Create a node

items.docs: Creates a new node resource representing a backend server on the network. Nodes are the foundation for pool members.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Get a specific node

params.name: nodeName
params.description: Name of the node resource, optionally prefixed with the partition path.

items.docs: Retrieves a single node resource including its address, monitoring status, and configuration.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Update a node

params.name: nodeName
params.description: Name of the node resource, optionally prefixed with the partition path.

items.docs: Replaces the configuration of an existing node resource.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Delete a node

params.name: nodeName
params.description: Name of the node resource, optionally prefixed with the partition path.

items.docs: Removes a node resource from the BIG-IP system. The node must not be referenced by any pool members.

info.name: Monitors
F5 Load Balancer List HTTP health monitors

items.docs: Retrieves all HTTP health monitors configured on the BIG-IP system. HTTP monitors verify availability by sending HTTP requests to pool members and evaluating the responses.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Create an HTTP health monitor

items.docs: Creates a new HTTP health monitor that sends HTTP requests to pool members to verify their availability and responsiveness.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer List HTTPS health monitors

items.docs: Retrieves all HTTPS health monitors configured on the BIG-IP system. HTTPS monitors verify availability over TLS-encrypted connections.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer List TCP health monitors

items.docs: Retrieves all TCP health monitors configured on the BIG-IP system. TCP monitors verify that pool members are accepting connections on the specified port.

info.name: Profiles
F5 Load Balancer List HTTP profiles

items.docs: Retrieves all HTTP traffic profiles on the BIG-IP system. HTTP profiles configure how the BIG-IP processes HTTP traffic including compression, caching, and header manipulation.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer List TCP profiles

items.docs: Retrieves all TCP traffic profiles on the BIG-IP system. TCP profiles optimize TCP connection behavior for different application and network scenarios.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer List client SSL profiles

items.docs: Retrieves all client-side SSL profiles on the BIG-IP system. Client SSL profiles manage TLS/SSL termination for connections between clients and the BIG-IP.

info.name: Policies
F5 Load Balancer List local traffic policies

items.docs: Retrieves all local traffic policies on the BIG-IP system. Policies provide rule-based traffic steering, content manipulation, and request/response modification.

info.name: iRules
F5 Load Balancer List iRules

items.docs: Retrieves all iRule resources on the BIG-IP system. iRules are Tcl-based scripts that provide custom traffic management logic for virtual servers.

info.name: SSL Certificates
F5 Load Balancer List SSL certificates

items.docs: Retrieves all SSL certificate files installed on the BIG-IP system that are available for use in SSL profiles.

info.name: Data Groups
F5 Load Balancer List internal data groups

items.docs: Retrieves all internal data groups on the BIG-IP system. Data groups provide address, string, and integer lookups used in iRules and traffic policies for decision-making.

info.name: SNAT Pools
F5 Load Balancer List SNAT pools

items.docs: Retrieves all SNAT pool resources on the BIG-IP system. SNAT pools define collections of translation addresses used for outbound connection source address translation.

info.name: System
F5 Load Balancer Get system information

items.docs: Retrieves top-level system information and available sub-collections for the BIG-IP system.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer Get system software version

items.docs: Retrieves the software version information for the BIG-IP system including product name, version, build number, and edition.

info.name: F5 Load Balancer List BIG-IP devices

items.docs: Retrieves information about all BIG-IP devices in the device trust group, including hostname, management address, failover state, and device group membership.
